GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat rail 3-4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, running on took over passing 200m and drew clear # had run/too good
Jumped Fair drifted back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # back/no threat
Jumped Ok sat rail 3-4l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well without really threatening # on-pace dominated
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mnt, which was racing without blinkers, did not display the same turn of foot as when it won at previous start & only ground its way to the line. Stable rep stated that, at its previous start, gelding had stepped up to 1500m for the first time & had travelled keenly in early stages, as noted in the Stwds Report. He advised the blinkers were removed on this occasion in an effort to have gelding travel more genuinely. He added that, whilst it appeared to have worked with the gelding traveling more comfortably, they will nevertheless consider adding blinkers for next start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, took over approaching 200m and drew clear # soft win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced keenly in the  early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 4l off held up, off heels approaching 200m 5l off then ran on strong late # held up/ran on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: COT: Ridden more fwd. Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced keenly behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Held Ground until held up 3 Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & ran on well in last 200m. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: to be ridden in a more forward position – settled near midfield. Began only fairly. Rounding the home turn was held up and unable to improve when awkwardly placed behind runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (barrier blanket first time) slow out x 1 length . Settled Down 7th Inside Just 5 Lengths @ 700m. railed Straightening Up . came off fence for Clear 200m, Kept Finding line # ran on soundly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and then from the wide barrier was shifted behind runners. Raced keenly in the early stages. Held up for clear running from the 400m until passing the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out improved, sat handy 2 Lengths off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, kept on one pace # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was bumped by a runner which shifted out. Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 700m had to be steadied when improving onto the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled near last 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on one pace # on-pace dominated
Jumped Fair drifted back 5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # back/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and then from a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
